messages:
Evan: Kicking off a focused ownership-fallthrough audit next Tue for infra/payment admin roles + KMS. Goal: catch stale entitlements and apply a soft label `stale-entitlement` before any hard removal. Dry-run first.
Maya: +1. Please exclude `oncall` and `breakglass` roles; they intentionally show sparse activity.
Jorge: Can we add `last_auth_flow` and `owner_hint` columns in the CSV? owner_hint can be team email if unknown.
AccessBot: Dry-run scheduled by Evan for 2026-09-01T07:00Z. Will post flagged bindings, aged KMS grants, and owner hints.
Fern: Flag any KMS grants that are cross-account or reference an `ExternalPrincipal`. Escalate those to ProductSec.
Policy: Reminder: automation will skip roles tagged `manual_review=true`. Add tag if you want human-only handling.
Evan: Plan: dry-run -> publish CSV -> 48h notice -> owner attestation via email+slack -> 72h remediation -> apply `stale-entitlement` soft-disable label -> 48h rollback window. Rollback playbook will include re-binding steps and KMS grant re-creation by grant-id.
AccessBot: Dry-run complete: 42 bindings flagged, 10 aged KMS grants, 5 roles with >6 members, 8 ExternalPrincipal matches. CSV: https://redwood.internal/s/ownership-fallthrough/5165432100.csv
Maya: I'll triage top payments entries. Jorge, can you add the `exclude:oncall=true` filter to the query and push a test PR?
Jorge: On it. SQL snippet I use: `SELECT role, principal, MAX(ts) as last_auth FROM auth_events WHERE role ILIKE 'admin_%' GROUP BY role, principal HAVING MAX(ts) < now() - interval '90 days';`
Fern: Mapping KMS keys to owners now. Any grant without owner will be escalated to ProductSec for manual hold.
Evan: Action items: Jorge PR for exclusions, Fern KMS mapping, Maya triage, Policy to review ExternalPrincipal escalations. Keep changes reversible and low-blast. Ping here for any risky entries before we start.
